敬虔なる高弟たちよ……<br>ついにその時が来た:
Devout disciples...
The time has finally come.
地上の絶望を食らい、<br>形を成すがいい！:
Devour the despair on the surface,
and take form!
恐れるな。その苦しみもまた<br>救済への産声なのだ！:
Fear not. That suffering is also
the first cry of salvation!
出でよ、神の御使い……<br>『煉獄の御使い』よ！！:
Come forth, God's messenger...
'Angel of Purgatory'!!
あまりに邪悪な姿……<br>本当に、神の使いか？:
Such an evil form...

愚かな。この姿こそが<br>”滅び”を司る神の威容だ！:
Foolish. This very form

汝が抱きし憎悪を<br>すべて地上に放て！:
Unleash all the hatred you bear

あ、ああ……！<br>これこそ我らが望んだ救済だ！:
Ah, ah...!
This is the salvation we've longed for!
お導きあれ！<br>地上の愚者に裁きを！:
Guide us!
Bring judgment upon the fools of the earth!
救済あれ！<br>滅びあれ！ 我らに光を！！:
Let there be salvation!
Let there be destruction! Bring us light!!
行け、我が御使いよ。<br>地上のすべてを焼き尽くせ！:
Go, my messenger.
Burn everything on the face of the earth!
行かれた……。<br>ついに審判が始まる！:
It's gone...
The judgment begins at last!
預言の通りだ！<br>素晴らしい救いの日だ！:
Just as the prophecy said!
What a glorious day of salvation!
フフフ……ハハハ！<br>滅びこそが真の救済！:
Heh heh heh... Ha ha ha!

You fools of the earth...
Sink into a sea of fire!

Let us proceed to even
deeper depths!
